title: Staff of a Mumbling Wizard

sources.title: Firebolt?
markers: | description = Hurl a mote of fire.

sources.title: Fireball
markers: | description = Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity for {{DamageText|8d6|Fire}} damage.

fields.Weapon profile: Simple, Versatile, 5 ft melee, Dippable. 1d6 one-handed or 1d8 two-handed Bludgeoning plus Strength.
fields.Firebolt?: Action, 60 ft, ranged spell attack. Deal 1d10 Fire with no level scaling. There is a 5% chance to create Fireball at impact, dealing 8d6 Fire within 13 ft with a DEX save for half.
fields.Acquisition: Consolation prize from Akabi’s wheel at the Circus of the Last Days.
fields.Topple: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon attack for 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Prone for 1 turn. Prone breaks Concentration and expires at the start of the target’s turn. Topple skips main-hand weapon effects.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
